an5.137:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave appaṃ rattiyā supanti, bahuṃ jagganti.
an5.137:1.3: itthi bhikkhave purisādhippāyā appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati.
an5.137:1.4: puriso bhikkhave itthidhippāyo appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati.
an5.137:1.5: coro bhikkhave ādānādhippāyo appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati.
an5.137:1.6: rājā bhikkhave rājakaraṇiyesu yutto appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati.
an5.137:1.7: bhikkhu bhikkhave visaṃyogādhippāyo appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati.
an5.137:1.8: imehi kho bhikkhave pañca appaṃ rattiyā supanti, bahuṃ jaggantīti.
